'''''Alisma triviale''''', the '''northern water plantain''',<ref name=plants/> is a [[perennial]] semi-[[aquatic plants|aquatic]] or aquatic plant in the water-plantain family ([[Alismataceae]]).

== Description ==
[[File:Alisma triviale.jpg|thumb|''Alisma triviale'']]
It is a perennial herb that ranges in height from 1-3 ft.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.wildflower.org/plants/result.php?id_plant=ALTR7|title=Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center - The University of Texas at Austin|website=www.wildflower.org|access-date=2019-04-03}}</ref> Each plant has long-petioled, lanceolate and linear leaves that grow in a clump.<ref name=":0" /> A flowering stem rises between them. The flowers have 3 green sepals and 3 white or pink-tinged petals.<ref name=":0" />

== Distribution and habitat ==
The plant is native to [[Canada]] (including the [[Northwest Territories]]), the [[United States]] (including [[Alaska]]), and Northern [[Mexico]].<ref>{{eFloras|1|222000009|Alisma triviale |family=Alismataceae |first1=Robert R. |last1=Haynes |first2=C. Barre |last2=Hellquist |access-date=2010-03-19}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://wcsp.science.kew.org/namedetail.do?name_id=294876 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201205091251/http://wcsp.science.kew.org/namedetail.do?name_id=294876 |url-status=dead |archive-date=December 5, 2020 |title=''Alisma triviale'' |work=[[World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]] (WCSP) |publisher=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]] }}</ref><ref>{{BONAP|ref|genus=Alisma|species=triviale}}</ref>

It grows in shallow water or mud.<ref>[http://wisplants.uwsp.edu/scripts/detail.asp?SpCode=ALITRI Robert W. Freckmann Herbarium University of Wisconsin Stevens Point] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100614093626/http://wisplants.uwsp.edu/scripts/detail.asp?SpCode=ALITRI|date=2010-06-14}} Retrieved 2010-03-19.</ref>
